text:
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATIC] Canary alert — p95 latency = 2.1s (threshold 1.8s). Suggesting automatic rollback to serving v3.4.0 for canary traffic. Auto action window: 5m. To override: /deploy override rollback --id=canary-1778. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/canary/overview
Alex: Hold on auto-rollback. Pilot customer traffic is on this canary. Do not rollback without human check. Can we isolate/pin those pilots?
Jordan: What's the root signal? pure latency or errors too? Need top endpoints and histogram before reverting.
Lee: Grafana link (last 10m): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/canary/p95?from=now-10m
Seeing p95 jump on /generate and embed route. Also correlating with increased KV cache misses on gpu-3. CPU steal reported on node pool 'pool-gpu-3'. No 5xx spike though.
Sam: Proposal: apply manual hold to suppress auto-rollback. Steps: 1) run smoke tests against v3.4.1, 2) pin dedicated pilot pools to v3.4.1, 3) rollback hosted (non-pilot) to v3.4.0 so customer-facing latency improves while we investigate. Ops to confirm feasibility.
Pat: I'll draft a short release note and customer heads-up if we do a targeted rollback. Suggested text: "Rolling back hosted to 3.4.0 due to latency regression detected in canary; pilot tenants remain on 3.4.1 while we investigate."
ops-runbot: Manual override CLI snippets: 
```
# apply temporary hold (10m)
deployctl override --scope=canary --action=hold --by=Alex --expires=10m
# pin pilot pool
deployctl pin --pool=dedicated-pilot --version=3.4.1
# rollback hosted
deployctl rollback --scope=hosted --version=3.4.0 --reason="canary p95 regression"
```
Will run pin now if authorized.
Jordan: Running smoke: `curl -sS https://canary.api.redwood/health` -> 200 OK (10/10). Doing a perf run against /generate with 8 concurrent clients now. Tail logs show intermittent `kvcache_miss` bursts matching latency spikes.
Alex: I authorize the manual hold and partial plan. Hold for 10m while Jordan runs perf tests and ops pins the pilot pool. If p95 doesn't drop in 10m, proceed with hosted rollback.
deploy-bot: Override acknowledged — manual hold applied by Alex. Auto-rollback suppressed. Pin task queued for dedicated-pilot and hosted rollback job queued (staged). deploy-id: db-1778882222-OVR
Pat: Drafted customer note and release note in #release-notes draft. Will post to pilots and update after Jordan's perf results.
Jordan: Perf run complete: targeted p95 down ~0.4s when diverting 60% of non-pilot traffic off canary, kvcache_miss rate reduced after pin simulation. Sharing raw numbers in thread.
Alex: Good. Keep the hold for one more cycle while we confirm telemetry. If stable, ops proceed with staged rollback for hosted and send the customer comms.
Pat: Acknowledged. Preparing final blurb and support playbook for any escalations.
